exposure: compliance to the national vaccination program
outcome: Risk of >3 episodes of otitis media
cohort: 50,000 mother-child pairs from the Danish National Birth Cohort (1996-2002)
finding: Short duration of breastfeeding, early introduction to daycare, cesarean section, and low vaccine compliance were associated with an increased risk of >3 episodes of otitis media at 18 months and 7 years of age.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of >3 episodes of otitis media at 18 months and 7 years of age.
